title: LifeWeaver
description: An app that rescues fading memories and weaves scattered messages and photos into the story of a life. Features media cleaning and voice-note transcription, an AI-assisted daily journal exportable as PDF, AI-narrated life chapters and relationship arcs, facial recognition across photos, and privacy-controlled chapter sharing. Backend architected with FastAPI and Celery for async task processing, backed by PostgreSQL, deployed on AWS to support 1,000+ concurrent users.

title: CRM Platform
description: A customer relationship management system built with .NET Core and Blazor, covering customer/contact management, data tracking, and dashboard views — backed by Entity Framework and SQL Server for data persistence.

title: AI Research Agent
description: An AI research agent that grounds LLM responses in real-time web data instead of relying on static training knowledge. Searches the web via DuckDuckGo, crawls and extracts real page content with Crawl4AI, then generates fact-checked answers from that live data. Supports a user-selectable LLM backend — cloud API via Pollinations AI, or local/offline via Ollama running Qwen2.5:14B — depending on speed, cost, or privacy needs.

title: AI Stock-Media Content Creator
description: A next-gen content creation tool that searches stock media, trending news visuals, historical footage, and generates imaginative AI scenes — then auto-syncs everything with narration to produce ready-to-publish short videos.

title: Smart Subtitle Generator
description: An AI-powered tool that automatically generates accurate subtitles for videos — ideal for enhancing accessibility and multilingual support.

title: Universal Video Translator
description: A content creation tool using stock media and AI that translates audio and video — enabling global audience reach with translated content and voiceovers.

title: Clip Composer & Editor
description: A drag-and-drop video clip combiner that helps you create polished video content by merging, ordering, and trimming clips with ease — perfect for quick content creation.

title: Modern E-commerce Platform
description: An all-in-one full-stack e-commerce solution with admin dashboard, inventory management and user notifications — ready to power scalable online stores.

title: Freight Dispatch Portal
description: A dispatch and logistics web-app designed for freight companies to manage shipments, clients and operations — optimized for real-world logistics workflow.

title: AI-Powered German Reading Assistant
description: An intelligent web app that leverages cutting-edge LLMs to generate personalized German reading content. Users can practice any level (A1–C2), explore topic-based scenarios, and listen to AI-narrated text — merging language learning with AI-driven content creation.
